name: radar-chart
purpose: Accessible SVG radar (polar) chart comparing a few series across several quantitative axes arranged clockwise around a circle: each series is a closed, optionally filled polygon with a focusable vertex per axis on a shared radial scale, a legend of toggle buttons, tooltips, a generated summary, and a data table fallback.
whenToUse: Comparing the profile of 1-5 items across 3-12 comparable measures on the same scale (skills, product attributes, scores).
whenNotToUse: Precise comparison of values: use Bar Chart (grouped).
Measures on different scales or units (the scale is shared).
Many series (polygons overlap) or ordered data such as time: use Line Chart.
states: empty (no series or no finite values: No data)
responsive: The width follows the container (ResizeObserver) and the height is the height option; the radius fits the smaller dimension after reserving room for axis names, which are truncated when space is short. Reflows at 320 CSS px; wide data tables scroll in a focusable region.
rtl: Axes keep clockwise order from the top (like pie charts, decision C5); ArrowLeft/ArrowRight are swapped so forward follows the reading direction. Legend, tooltip, and table follow the document direction.
theme: Series use color-chart-1..8 by palette slot (outline, vertices, 12% fill); rings and spokes color-chart-grid; ring ticks color-text-muted; axis names color-text. Forced colors use CanvasText and Highlight.
security: All text (title, description, axis names, values, tooltip, table) is set with textContent; SVG is built with createElementNS. Colors are CSS classes; sizes and the tooltip position are written through the CSSOM (style.setProperty). No innerHTML, no style attributes, no inline handlers: works under style-src without unsafe-inline and require-trusted-types-for.
dataHandling: Renders the data it is given; no persistence, network access, or telemetry. Values are not logged; validation errors name the option, never its value.

budgets.metric: RadarChart.create with 5 series x 12 axes, including the first render
budgets.budget: < 30 ms in headless Chromium (e2e performance test)

performance.testedScale: Designed for up to about 5 series and 12 axes; every vertex is a focusable SVG path.

limitations: One shared radial scale for all axes; no per-axis scales.
Missing values are drawn at the center (no gaps in the polygon).
valueAxis.label and valueAxis.includeZero are accepted but not used.
unsupported: Per-axis scales or units, polar area (rose) and radial bar charts.
antiPatterns: Comparing polygon areas (area depends on axis order).
Mixing measures with different units on one scale.
